question: Did Broadcom's Q3 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue beat the guidance it gave on its Q2 FY2026 call, and by how much in dollars and percent?
grading: Beat amount ±$0.1B; beat % ±0.5pp; must benchmark against the company's AI semiconductor revenue guide
answer: Broadcom Q3 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue was $16.7 billion versus its Q2-release guidance of $16.0 billion: a $0.7 billion beat, or 4.375% of guidance. [G18-E1, G18-E2]

output.answer:
**Yes, Broadcom beat its Q3 FY2026 AI semiconductor guidance.**

| Metric | Guidance (from Q2 FY2026 call) | Q3 FY2026 Actual | Beat |
|--------|-------------------------------|------------------|------|
| AI Semiconductor Revenue | **$16.0 billion** | **$16.7 billion** | **+$0.7 billion** |
| YoY Growth | "over 200%" | 221% | — |

- **Dollar beat:** **$700 million** (or $0.7 billion)
- **Percent beat vs. guidance:** **~4.4%** ($0.7B ÷ $16.0B)

**Sources:**

- Q2 FY2026 guidance of $16.0 billion: [Broadcom Q2 FY2026 earnings release](https://investors.broadcom.com/node/64371/pdf) and [Futurum analysis](https://futurumgroup.com/insights/broadcom-q2-fy-2026-vmware-stability-supports-ai-led-semiconductor-expansion)
- Q3 FY2026 actual of $16.7 billion: [Broadcom Q3 FY2026 earnings release (PR Newswire)](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/broadcom-inc-announces-third-quarter-fiscal-year-2026-financial-results-and-quarterly-dividend-302868129.html) and [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/broadcom-inc-avgo-q3-2026-110030403.html)
